trello.name: Fix Android photo upload crash
trello.desc: Marcus will address the NullPointerException crash in the media picker callback when the user backgrounds the app mid-upload. This fix should be implemented and verified by Wednesday to allow QA testing before the mobile release on August 20th. Sam will confirm the fix on Android 14 test devices.

trello.name: Implement offline mode for notes list
trello.desc: Elena will build the backend sync API, allowing the client to send its last-synced timestamp and receive a delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. Marcus will handle the client side, implementing a local cache in Room, queuing writes while offline, and replaying them when connectivity is restored. Acceptance criteria include app functionality in airplane mode, with notes visible and editable, and data reconciliation upon reconnection.

trello.name: Migrate CI pipelines to GitHub Actions
trello.desc: Sam will complete the migration of test and release pipelines to GitHub Actions, maintaining the current nightly build schedule. Both Jenkins and GitHub Actions will run in parallel for a week to ensure stability before discontinuing Jenkins.

trello.name: Add per-user rate limiting to search endpoint
trello.desc: Elena will implement per-user rate limiting (100 requests per minute) on the search endpoint, returning HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header if the limit is exceeded. Metrics counters should be added to monitor usage and identify users hitting the limit.

trello.name: Update privacy policy screen for GDPR compliance
trello.desc: Marcus will update the consent screen to meet GDPR requirements, ensuring it includes opt-in toggles for analytics and marketing instead of a single pre-checked box. This update is critical for the August 20 release as it is a launch blocker.

trello.name: Automate payments flow tests in CI
trello.desc: Sam will create regression tests for the payments flow, covering purchase, restore, cancellation, and receipt validation. These tests will be integrated into the new GitHub Actions pipeline to ensure robust coverage and prevent future issues.
